The '''Chern Medal''' is an international award recognizing outstanding lifelong achievement of the highest level in the field of [[mathematics]]. The prize is given at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] (ICM), which is held every four years.

==Introduction==
Named in honor of the late Chinese mathematician [[Shiing-Shen Chern]], the award is a joint effort of the [[International Mathematical Union]] (IMU) and the '''Chern Medal Foundation''' (CMF) to be bestowed in the same fashion as the IMU's other three awards (the [[Fields Medal]], the [[Nevanlinna Prize|Abacus Medal]], and the [[Gauss Prize]]), i.e. at the opening ceremony of the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] (ICM), which is held every four years. The first such occasion was at the 2010 ICM in [[Hyderabad, India]].<ref name="Chern Medal">{{cite web |url=http://www.mathunion.org/general/prizes/chern/details/ |title=Chern Medal Award |publisher=[[International Congress of Mathematicians]] (ICM) |year=2010 |accessdate=August 22, 2010 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100825071850/http://www.mathunion.org/general/prizes/chern/details |archive-date=August 25, 2010 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

Each recipient receives a medal decorated with Chern's likeness, a cash prize of $250,000 ([[USD]]), and the opportunity to direct $250,000 of charitable donations to one or more organizations for the purpose of supporting research, education, or outreach in mathematics.<ref name="Chern Medal"/>

==Laureates==

{| class="wikitable"
! scope="col"| Award year 
! scope="col"|  Winner 
! scope="col"|  Reasons
|-
| 2010 
| [[Louis Nirenberg]] 
| "For his role in the formulation of the modern theory of non-linear elliptic [[partial differential equations]] and for mentoring numerous students and post-docs in this area."<ref name="Chern Medal 2010">{{cite web |url=http://www.icm2010.in/prize-winners-2010/chern-medal-louis-nirenberg |title=Chern Medal – Louis Nirenberg |publisher=ICM 2010 |date=August 19, 2010 |accessdate=August 22, 2010 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120724045404/http://www.icm2010.in/prize-winners-2010/chern-medal-louis-nirenberg |archive-date=July 24, 2012 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
|-
| 2014 
| [[Phillip Griffiths]]
| "For his groundbreaking and transformative development of transcendental methods in [[complex geometry]], particularly his seminal work in [[Hodge theory]] and periods of algebraic varieties."<ref name="14reasons">{{cite web |url=https://www.mathunion.org/imu-awards/chern-medal/chern-medal-award-2014 |title=Chern Medal Award 2014 |publisher=International Mathematical Union |website=mathunion.org}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.ias.edu/press-releases/phillip-griffiths-awarded-chern-medal |title=Phillip Griffiths Awarded Chern Medal |website=Institute for Advanced Study}}</ref>
|-
| 2018
| [[Masaki Kashiwara]]
| "For his outstanding and foundational contributions to algebraic analysis and representation theory sustained over a period of almost 50 years."<ref name="18reasons">{{cite web |url=https://www.mathunion.org/imu-awards/chern-medal-award/chern-medal-award-2018 |title=Chern Medal Award 2018 |publisher=International Mathematical Union |website=mathunion.org}}</ref>
|-
| 2022
| [[Barry Mazur]]
| "For his profound discoveries in topology, arithmetic geometry and number theory, and his leadership and generosity in forming the next generation of Mathematicians."<ref name="22reasons">{{cite web |url=https://www.mathunion.org/imu-awards/chern-medal-award/chern-medal-award-2022 |title=Chern Medal Award 2022 |publisher=International Mathematical Union |website=mathunion.org}}</ref>
|-
| 2026
| [[Graeme Segal]]
| "For his visionary mathematical insights that have had an enduring influence in a wide range of fields, including topology, mathematical physics, representation theory and category theory."<ref name="j846">{{cite web | title=Chern Medal Award 2026 | website=www.mathunion.org | url=https://www.mathunion.org/imu-awards/chern-medal-award/chern-medal-award-2026 | access-date=July 24, 2026}}</ref>
|-
|}
